requirements.heading: SPF and Internationalized Mail
requirements.text: Since the EHLO command precedes the server response that tells whether the server supports the SMTPUTF8 extension, an IDN host name MUST be represented as A-labels.

requirements.heading: SPF and Internationalized Mail
requirements.text: All U-labels MUST be converted to A-labels before being used for an SPF validation.

requirements.heading: SPF and Internationalized Mail
requirements.text: Section 4.3 of [RFC7208] states that all IDNs in an SPF DNS record MUST be A-labels; this rule is unchanged since any SPF record can be used to authorize either EAI or conventional mail.

requirements.heading: DKIM and Internationalized Mail
requirements.text: Section 3.5 of [RFC6376] states that IDNs in the d=, i=, and s= tags of a DKIM-Signature header field MUST be encoded as A-labels.

requirements.heading: DKIM and Internationalized Mail
requirements.text: This rule is relaxed only for internationalized message header fields [RFC6532], so IDNs SHOULD be represented as U-labels.

requirements.heading: DKIM and Internationalized Mail
requirements.text: When computing or verifying the hash in a DKIM signature as described in Section 3.7 of [RFC6376], the hash MUST use the domain name in the format it occurs in the header field.
